Sudan’s health system, staff and facilities are equally under constant attack. Ultimately, the best medicine is peace.”

### ‘People are eating things that are not food’ [...] Over 80% of hospitals and primary health facilities in conflict areas are closed. Across the country, 37% of health facilities are “non-functional,” according to WHO. The trend in Zambia holds worldwide: 44 countries saw cholera outbreaks in 2022, a 25% increase over 2021. Last year, 30 nations experienced cholera—nine of which recorded more than 10,000 cases. [...] Although cholera isn't unusual in Zambia, the scale of this outbreak is alarming health-care workers, public health officials, politicians, and the general population alike.

While cases have finally started to decline, more than 20,000 people have been infected and over 700 have died from the disease.
